name: Skyline Open 2018

venue.name: Skyline High School
venue.details: Titan Gym in the Gym Wing

information:
The competitor limit is set to 110 due to the size of the venue. 
We are unable to provide online registration payment because our school does not allow us to receive money on the WCA website. Thus, we will be only be accepting at-the-door payment, **please bring $20 in cash to the competition to pay for registration**. 
Spectators are free to watch the competition, but please limit the number of spectators you bring for the sake of space.
